card.name: Inside the word suicidality in warnings
card.fires_on: The middle piece of the word suicidal or suicidality, mainly the 'ID' piece in boxed-warning headings such as 'WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS AND BEHAVIORS'. It also shows up weakly in a few other split words.

modes.label: Boxed warning heading
modes.description: The 'ID' piece inside SUICIDAL or SUICIDALITY in capitalised warning titles.
modes.example: BOXED WARNING WARNING: SUIC<<ID>>AL THOUGHTS AND BEHAV

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Odd word pieces in the middle of other words, such as an ID code or a drawing layer name.
modes.example: Minorities," The Centre for Market and Public Organisation 05/130, Department of Economics, University of Bristol, UK. - re<<pec>>:cep:cepsps:2

card.plain: It fires in the middle of the word suicidal in the capitalised boxed warning about suicidal thoughts and behaviors.
evidence: BOXED WARNING WARNING: SUIC<<ID>>AL THOUGHTS AND BEHAV
